summary: Both workspace clean scripts invoke Rimraf 5 syntax, while Rimraf 6 requires Node.js 20 or newer.

findings.title: Confirm Node.js 20 for clean scripts
findings.impact: The CLI and core packages directly run Rimraf during clean; those commands will no longer run on Node.js versions older than 20 after this upgrade.
recommendedChecks: Confirm local and CI jobs use Node.js 20 or newer, then run the existing clean scripts for both packages.

omittedConcerns: The new --version option is omitted because the repository evidence does not show that command being used.
